column1: # ARTIFACT-V0-008 declared permission exceptions (V1-1469), read by script/check-ci-least-privilege.sh
# from the Git index. Every other workflow-level or job-level `permissions:` block in
# .github/workflows/*.yml must be exactly `contents: read`. One row per block, tab-separated:
# workflow, block (`workflow` or `job:<id>`), the exact permission set as space-separated
# scope:level tokens, and the reason. A row that matches no block fails the check.

column4: SOP-V0-013: comments on or opens the nightly-triage issue after a failed scheduled run on main; runs only .github/nightly-signal from the scheduled commit; pinned by TestSOPV0013WorkflowBinding

AFP-V0-530 (V1-2682 option A): the weekly scheduled main-only flake report lists and downloads the ci-flaky-<event>-<shard> artifacts of the window (actions: read) and updates the one open ci-flake-report issue in place (issues: write); runs only .github/flake-report and tools/ci-flake-report from main; pinned by TestAFPV0530WorkflowBinding

AFP-V0-097 (V1-2270): the scheduled main-only forward bar lists the epoch's forward-row artifacts and downloads them to compute the AFP-V0-029 verdict; read-only, posts no status and runs only .github/forward-rows from main
AFP-V0-097 (V1-2270): the verdict job reads the forward-row artifacts of completed CI runs and retains afp-shadow-bar-epoch-<N>; read-only, posts no status
AFP-V0-097 (V1-2270): reads the newest afp-shadow-bar-epoch-<N> artifact of ci-forward-bar.yml with accept.sh from the pull request's base commit; read-only, runs no pull-request code
CIN-V0-4625 (V1-4732): reads the newest afp-shadow-bar-epoch-<N> artifact of ci-forward-bar.yml with accept.sh from the pull request's base commit; read-only, runs no pull-request code

AFP-V0-170 (V1-2271): the reuse step reads the jobs listing of a candidate run and the log of its ci-tested-tree-record job, which needs actions: read; read-only, posts nothing, and only decides REUSE or FULL
AFP-V0-016/026: workflow_run from the default branch posts the ci-control-plane status on the PR head or merge-queue commit; reads PR metadata only, never checks out PR code
AFP-V0-047: reads completed CI run artifacts to record forward rows; read-only, posts no status
AFP-V0-163: a merge-queue entry reads the jobs listing and the artifact-integrity-record job log of the pull-request run that verified its tree; read-only, the token reaches only the reuse step

AFP-V0-670/671 (V1-2987): a merge-queue entry reads the jobs listing and the doc-gates-record job log of the pull-request run that passed doc-gates on its tree, and a main push reads the jobs listing of its merge-queue run; read-only, posts nothing, and only decides REUSE or FULL

AFP-V0-670/672 (V1-2987): a merge-queue entry reads the jobs listing and the cem-release-record job log of the pull-request run that passed the CEM release gate on its tree, and a main push reads the jobs listing of its merge-queue run; read-only, posts nothing, and only decides REUSE or FULL

AFP-V0-983 (V1-3750): a failed full push run of main reads completed CI run artifacts and the jobs listing with gh to link it back to narrowed pull requests; read-only, runs only .github/forward-rows from the default-branch commit, posts no status

V1-4360: the hourly main-only prune lists the codeql-overlay-base-database-* Actions cache entries and deletes all but the newest of each key prefix, so CodeQL's per-push overlay databases stop evicting the go-build cache; checks out nothing and runs no repository code
CIN-V0-7501: reads the narrowing verdict and prior run evidence; read-only, no status writes

AFP-V0-106 (V1-4234): the daily scheduled main-only fast-route liveness check lists the newest ci.yml runs and each run's jobs listing with steps (actions: read); reads no log or artifact, posts nothing, read-only

GRG-V0-001: reads the pull request, its Greptile summary comment and review threads, and posts the greptile-gate commit status on the PR head and its merge-group commit; runs from the default branch, checks out nothing and runs no pull-request code

AFP-V0-2327 (V1-1097): lists this pull request's CI runs and successful merge-queue runs and downloads their test-reuse records to decide which packages to reuse; read-only, posts nothing; disabled (if: false) until protected collector qualification
